name: trikefair-android
description: Android (Capacitor) packaging for the PANAW (formerly TRIKEFAIR) web app in trikefair_final/trikefair. The web app itself is not modified.

scripts.sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug && copy /Y app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk ..\PANAW.apk
scripts.sync:online: npm run build:www:online && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:online: npm run sync:online && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug && copy /Y app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk ..\PANAW-online.apk
